title: Set 208

sentences.ko: 한동안 그림 그리는 데 완전 빠졌었는데, 사람들이 인터넷에 올리는 거랑 자꾸 내 걸 비교하게 돼서 그냥 좀 손을 놓게 됐어. 지금은 물감이 다 어느 서랍 안에서 말라 가고 있어.
sentences.text: I got really into painting for a while, but I kept comparing mine to the stuff people post online, so I just kind of stopped, and now all the paints are drying out in a drawer somewhere.

alts.text: Painting was my thing for a bit, but I kept comparing it to stuff online, so I kinda quit, and now the paints are just drying up in some drawer.

I became quite interested in painting for a period of time, but I continually compared my work to what people share online, so I eventually stopped, and now all of the paints are drying out in a drawer somewhere.

sentences.note: **got really into** 는 무언가에 푹 빠졌다는 뜻이에요. **kind of** 는 말을 누그러뜨려서 그냥 좀, 어쩌다 보니 같은 느낌을 줍니다.

sentences.ko: 딸은 작년이랑 같은 선생님이야? 우리 애는 새로 온 남자 선생님이 맡았는데, 그냥 엄한 건지 진짜 우리 아들을 싫어하는 건지 아직 모르겠어서.
sentences.text: Did your daughter get the same teacher as last year? Because ours got a new guy, and I can't tell yet if he's just strict or if he really doesn't like my son.

alts.text: Your daughter have the same teacher again? We got some new guy, and I can't tell if he's just strict or if he's got it in for my kid.
Was your daughter assigned the same teacher as last year? Our son has a new teacher, and I cannot yet tell whether he is simply strict or whether he genuinely dislikes my son.

sentences.note: **I can't tell yet if** 는 아직 ~인지 판단이 안 선다는 말이에요. **a new guy** 는 새로 온 남자를 편하게 부르는 표현이고, **got it in for** 는 누구를 유독 싫어해서 벼르고 있다는 뜻입니다.

sentences.ko: 빨래 개면서 영상 하나 틀어 놨는데, 고개 들어 보니까 밖이 깜깜하고 사람들이 낡은 밴 고치는 걸 한 세 시간은 봤더라. 빨래는 그대로 놓여 있고.
sentences.text: I put on one video while I was folding laundry, and when I looked up, it was dark out and I'd watched like three hours of people fixing up old vans. And the laundry was still sitting there.

alts.text: Threw on one video while folding laundry, looked up, and it's dark and I've watched like three hours of guys fixing up old vans. Laundry's still sitting there.

I started one video while I was folding laundry, and when I looked up, it was dark outside and I had watched approximately three hours of people restoring old vans. The laundry was still sitting there as well.

sentences.note: **put on** 은 영상이나 음악을 튼다는 뜻이에요. **fixing up** 은 낡은 것을 손봐서 고친다는 말이고, 숫자 앞의 **like** 는 한, 대충이라는 뜻입니다.
sentences.situation: 유튜브 보다가 시간 다 날린 얘기

sentences.ko: 이모들이 둘째는 언제 낳냐고 계속 물어봐서 말을 돌리려고 했는데, 엄마까지 끼어들어서 이모들 편을 드는 거야. 그래서 그냥 음식 좀 보러 가야 하는 척했어.
sentences.text: My aunts kept asking when we're having a second kid, and I tried to change the subject, but then my mom jumped in on their side, so I just pretended I had to go check on the food.

alts.text: My aunts wouldn't stop asking when kid number two's coming, so I tried to switch topics, but then Mom took their side, so I just acted like I had to go check the food.

My aunts repeatedly asked when we would be having a second child, and I attempted to change the subject, but then my mother joined in on their side, so I simply pretended that I needed to check on the food.

sentences.note: **change the subject** 는 화제를 돌린다는 뜻이에요. **jumped in on their side** 는 대화에 끼어들어 그쪽 편을 들었다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 친척들 모인 자리에서 질문 공세 받은 얘기

sentences.ko: 버거 두 개 시켰는데 온 건 케빈이라는 사람 앞으로 된 샐러드랑 수프였어. 가게에 전화했더니 제대로 된 주문은 한 시간 더 걸린대서, 그냥 우리가 케빈 저녁을 먹었어.
sentences.text: We ordered two burgers, but what showed up was a salad and some soup for somebody named Kevin. I called them, but they said the right order would take another hour, so we just ate Kevin's dinner.

alts.text: Ordered two burgers, got a salad and some soup for some guy named Kevin. Called them, and they said it'd be another hour, so yeah, we ate Kevin's dinner.

We ordered two burgers, but what arrived was a salad and some soup intended for someone named Kevin. I called the restaurant, but they said the correct order would take another hour, so we simply ate Kevin's dinner.

sentences.note: **what showed up** 은 실제로 도착한 것이라는 뜻이에요. **take another hour** 는 한 시간이 더 걸린다는 말입니다.
sentences.situation: 배달 시켰는데 엉뚱한 게 와서 얘기하기

reviewed: 1번 한국어 '그냥 어쩌다 그만둬 버렸어'가 어색해서 kind of stopped 의 느낌대로 '그냥 좀 손을 놓게 됐어'로 고침
1번 casual 의 'holding mine up against stuff online'은 원어민이 잘 안 쓰는 말이라 'comparing it to stuff online'으로 고침
2번 casual 'Same teacher as last year for your daughter?'는 어순이 어색해서 더 자연스러운 구어 질문으로 바꾸고, 뒤쪽도 text 와 덜 겹치게 'got it in for my kid'로 고침
5번 casual 'Got two burgers? Nope'는 스스로 묻고 답하는 꼴이라 뜻이 헷갈려서 'Ordered two burgers, got a salad...'로 고침
